title: Divorce House: Keep vs. Sell
description: Price the largest check in a divorce two ways: keeping the marital home (refinance the balance plus the equity buyout at one income, carry taxes, insurance, and an upkeep reserve) versus selling (net proceeds after friction costs, invested at your return, with a rent reset that inflates). Compares net position at 5 and 10 years, reports the housing ratio with an affordability verdict, and flags refinance qualification and the 80% LTV/PMI line. Every figure is user-entered; deterministic arithmetic, not legal or tax advice.
data_vintage: Every figure is user-entered (balances, rates, rents, appreciation, returns). No market feeds, no rate tables, no stored data. Outputs are deterministic arithmetic over those inputs and are not legal or tax advice.

mcp_tool_definition.name: divorce_house_keep_vs_sell
mcp_tool_definition.description: Compare keeping the marital home versus selling in a divorce: keep path = refinance (balance plus equity buyout) at a single income with taxes, insurance, and upkeep; sell path = net proceeds after friction, invested at a return, against an inflating rent. Returns both paths' net position at 5 and 10 years, the housing ratio with affordability and refi-qualification flags, and the LTV/PMI line.
